description: AHP and iber reproductibility packages - "Urban flood hazard assessment semi-arid urban areas: a comparison of AHP and two-dimensional hydrodynamic modelling applied to Guercif (eastern Morocco)" EEET is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This reproducibility package contains the complete computational materials supporting the AHP susceptibility assessment and the two-dimensional Iber hydrodynamic modelling presented in the study. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
